content: MK infers from the Mafahis introduction that lettrism is, for Ibn Turka, the only form of metaphysics worth the name; the note cites MS Majlis 10196 f. 55a and MS Esad Efendi 1731 ff. 8b-9a, and adds that the letter alone is the coincidentia oppositorum, not offset by an opposite (MS Majlis 10196 f. 58a).
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, K. al-Mafaḥiṣ, MS Majlis 10196 ff. 55a, 58a
